tested.pop_html: I stayed at Maverick Central Market myself. Everything on this card comes from my own stay.What I checked: dorms, bathrooms, kitchen, noise and long-stay value. Full review ↓

pills.label: Privacy Curtains
pills.pop_html: Curtain on every bed. Modern dorms with privacy curtains and large lockers, so even a full room feels calm.Lock your valuables: I had a pullover stolen during my stay.

pills.label: Rooftop Terrace
pills.pop_html: A guest terrace up top. Social without being a party hostel: easy to meet people in the evening, then sleep.Crowd: solo travelers, long-stayers and remote workers.

pills.label: Quiet Side Street
pills.pop_html: Lónyay utca, District IX. A smaller side street away from the District VII party streets. Street noise was minimal across my 30 nights.Kálvin tér (M3, M4) and Fővám tér (M4, trams 2, 47, 49) are a short walk.

pills.label: Long-Stay Value
pills.pop_html: 30 nights for €280. That's about €9.33 a night in March, the best long-stay value I've found in central Budapest.Dorms from about €10 on near dates, privates from €28.

best_for.pick_html: for solo travelers, digital nomads and long-stay backpackers who want a social hostel without party noise.
best_for.skip_html: if you want a party hostel next to the ruin bars.

items.a: No. It is social without party noise: you meet people easily in the common areas, without 4 AM shouting in the corridors.

items.q: Is it good for a long stay?
items.a: Yes. I paid €280 for 30 nights in March, about €9.33 a night. Dorm beds start from about €10 on near dates.
Yes. It is on Lónyay utca, a smaller side street in District IX, and street noise was minimal across my 30 nights.

items.q: What should I watch out for?
items.a: The kitchen gets cramped at peak times and the fridge is always full. I had a pullover stolen, so use the large lockers.
Kálvin tér (M3, M4) and Fővám tér (M4, trams 2, 47, 49) are a short walk. Check-in from 15:00, check-out by 11:00, no curfew.

tested.pop_html: I stayed at Onefam Budapest myself. Everything on this card comes from my own stay.What I checked: rooms, storage, showers, activities and noise. Full review ↓

pills.label: Free Daily Activities
pills.pop_html: Something every day. Free daytime activities, then drinking games at the bar in the evening. The staff pull everyone in.Easiest place on this list to arrive solo and leave with a crew.

pills.label: Bar Crawls
pills.pop_html: Pub crawls into the ruin bars. The hostel party winds down around 11 PM to midnight, then the group heads out to the Jewish Quarter.No curfew; check-in 15:00 to 23:00.

pills.label: Ages 18 to 39
pills.pop_html: Strictly 18 to 39. Only guests aged 18 to 39 can stay, which keeps the crowd young and social.Over 39? Maverick has the social side without the age limit.

pills.label: Deák tér
pills.pop_html: 4 minutes to Deák Ferenc tér. M1, M2, M3 and the 100E airport bus, from Rumbach Sebestyén utca 6.Walking distance home from the bars.

best_for.pick_html: for solo travelers aged 18 to 39 who want an instant crew, daily activities and nights out.
best_for.skip_html: if you are over 39, travel as a couple wanting privacy, or want early nights.

items.a: Yes. Onefam takes guests aged 18 to 39 only.
Free daytime activities, then drinking games at the bar and pub crawls into the Jewish Quarter at night.
The party usually winds down around 11 PM to midnight, when the crowd heads out to the ruin bars.
There is no shelf on the bunks for your phone or wallet, the shower temperature can fluctuate, and it costs more than most Budapest hostels.

items.q: How do I get there from the airport?
items.a: Take the 100E airport bus to Deák Ferenc tér (also M1, M2, M3), about a 4-minute walk. Check-in runs 15:00 to 23:00.
